statement: Reasonix constructs a filtered child tool registry, supports a read-only child profile, caps recursive delegation by depth, hides parent-only orchestration and job tools, and gives each child a private temporary-session boundary.

display_text.zh-CN: Reasonix 会构造过滤后的 child tool registry，支持只读 child profile，按深度限制递归 delegation，隐藏 parent-only orchestration/job tools，并为每个 child 提供私有临时 session 边界。
display_text.en: Reasonix constructs a filtered child tool registry, supports a read-only child profile, caps recursive delegation by depth, hides parent-only orchestration and job tools, and gives each child a private temporary-session boundary.

evidence.title: Reasonix subagent tool and context boundaries

notes: This source map does not yet cover scheduler fairness, merge quality, or real concurrent mutation behavior.
